sunlit-forest.note: The canopy now reads green and the warm path is distinct. Sunlit yellow-green is somewhat muted, and dark trees and shaded ground remain too pale. Raising color strengthens green but does not restore dark volume.

forest-shadows.note: More color survives, but deep shade loses its dark mass and olive foliage becomes patchy gold. The woodland reads much lighter and drier than the photograph. A higher color amount does not fix this.

autumn-lake.note: Yellow foliage, blue sky and mirrored tree colors read clearly. Green shadow trees lose color and depth; near-neutral water patches gain some surrounding color. At 100% the broad blue fields can dominate.

alpine-lake.note: The lake is convincingly turquoise and rock slopes retain warm hues. Dark pines and mountain faces are much too light. Snow and clouds stay mostly uncolored, as they should.

sandstone-desert.note: Warm rock and cool sky colors are retained, but the terrain collapses toward one terracotta mass and some warm shadows become yellow. Pale cloud colors are omitted. At 100% color overwhelms some rock modeling.

wildflower-meadow.note: Red poppies, green plants and yellow flowers all survive. Small or pale details disappear, and blurred grasses become hard-edged color patches. The blue background competes with the flowers at high amounts.

turquoise-coast.note: Blue offshore water and turquoise shallows are distinguishable. Broad pale gaps remain near the boat and the water's highlights, while shadow foliage and rocks lose depth. More color strengthens existing marks without filling rejected areas.

colored-houses.note: Red and yellow buildings and reflections improve strongly. The muted blue facade is almost uncolored; several warm facades merge toward terracotta. Dark boats and canal reflections lose their silhouettes.

red-brick.note: Brick red, blue sky and teal signs remain separated; the white sign stays clean. Fine lettering is dark and small accents lose saturation, but the larger architectural color regions read well.

white-facade.note: White stone remains mostly neutral and architectural edges read clearly. Only a little sky blue survives; subtle window tint and the tree are weak. This is a useful check that the renderer does not color every pale surface.

glass-towers.note: Blue and teal glass accents and the red railing survive. Most subtle glass and stone colors are omitted, so the buildings still read predominantly monochrome despite their colored reflections.

night-city.note: Blue strips, red signs and purple accents survive, but black sky and building interiors become pale. Illuminated signs lose their brightness contrast. This needs stronger dark coverage before more saturation.
